shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/UserProfile.tsx app/ProductList.tsx package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json package-lock.json app/UserProfile.tsx app/page.tsx && git log --oneline -5 --decorate && git ls-files'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/UserProfile.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && echo '"'next-env cleanup: ok'"
/bin/bash -lc 'du -sh .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && find .next -type f | wc -l && file tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -delete && find tsconfig.tsbuildinfo -delete && git status --short && git diff --check'
